answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to prosecute B0100 while limiting post-launch exposure: it descends and turns westward to close the geometry, expends its last missile, then makes a sustained right-hand offset as the missile converges with B0100; their near-simultaneous removal supports the attack interpretation without proving a hit.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly prioritizes surviving B0100’s already-airborne missile while preserving its remaining weapon, using a fast northward extension with repeated heading corrections to keep both missile and launcher behind and west; continued extension after B0100 becomes inactive supports defensive disengagement rather than an attack setup.
